record.dic_text:
02157 Zamzom {zam-zome'}

源自 02161; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Zamzummims 1; 1

散送冥 = "陰謀者"
1) 亞捫人對利乏音人的稱呼, 其意思是表示一個巨人的大國; 可能和蘇西
   (Zuzim, <SNH02104>)指的相同 (#申2:20|)
record.edic_text:
02157 Zamzom {zam-zome'}

from 02161;; n pr m

AV - Zamzummims 1; 1

Zamzummims = "plotters"
1) the Ammonite name for the people who by others were called Rephaim,
   and were described as a numerous nation of giants; perhaps the same
   as 'Zuzim'
